function_question: How can a computer learn from rewards?

opening.text: There was a robot called Pixel who got a new pet: a little robot mouse.
The mouse wandered around its maze, bumping into walls and falling into traps, and it never found the cheese quickly.
Pixel wondered: "Nobody gave my mouse a map. What if it could learn the way just by earning rewards?"

card.place: A maze with cheese and traps
card.problem: The mouse wanders and gets lost

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: The lost mouse
chapters.line: Pixel's pet mouse has no map and no examples. It just tries moves.

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Pixel asks for help
chapters.line: How do you train a puppy? Pixel needs a teammate. What about you?

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: Learning by rewards
chapters.line: You and Pixel meet learners who get better by trial and error.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The secret of rewards
chapters.line: The rewards you choose decide what gets learned.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: The number-grid lab
chapters.line: No magic, just numbers! Pixel hands you a paper mouse and a 5×5 grid.

chapters.label: Chapter 5½
chapters.title: Remix the maze
chapters.line: Seven magic words, seven ways to change the maze.

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: Designing the maze
chapters.line: Start, cheese, a wall and a trap, plus a reward for each.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: Try after try
chapters.line: The mouse wanders at first, then starts to learn.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: Straight to the cheese
chapters.line: The mouse runs the shortest path and skips the trap.

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Pixel's pet mouse has no map, only the rewards you give it. Can you help design a reward system that teaches it the shortest path to the cheese and keeps it out of the traps? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some trainers already know a trick or two. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Some AI learns by trial and error, collecting rewards. Tap each card to meet four real-world learners!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four learners share…
guide.skill: Unplugged first! Which number grid gets your paper mouse to the cheese in the fewest steps? Predict, then move it.
guide.sketch: Time to design your maze like a real AI trainer!
guide.build_and_test: Run 5 tries in the Reward Maze and count the steps each try takes!
guide.retry_tip: Change ONE reward, predict what will happen, then run 5 more tries!
guide.ending: And ever since then, Pixel's mouse zooms straight to the cheese, because YOU chose the rewards that taught it!

quick_check.question: Try 1 takes 20 steps. Try 5 takes 8 steps. How many steps did the mouse save?
quick_check.right: Right! 20 take away 8 is 12. Fewer steps means the rewards are teaching it well.

clue_cards.name: Puppy training
clue_cards.trick: Every time the puppy sits, it earns a treat.
clue_cards.does: Rewarded behaviour happens more often, so it learns "sit".

clue_cards.name: Chess and Go AIs
clue_cards.trick: They played millions of games against themselves.
clue_cards.does: Earning a reward only for winning, they learned to play brilliantly.

clue_cards.name: Walking robots
clue_cards.trick: They're rewarded for every step they stay upright.
clue_cards.does: By trial and error, they learn to walk.

clue_cards.name: Video game characters
clue_cards.trick: They earn points and lose lives as they play.
clue_cards.does: They learn which moves pay off and which don't.

match_groups.label: 🏆 A reward only at the end

predict.prompt: Will this reward teach the mouse the right lesson? Predict first!
predict.explain: The mouse learns whatever earns rewards. Paying it for every step teaches it to wander about taking extra steps, not to find the cheese fast!

lab.title: The number-grid lab
lab.predict: Which reward grid gets your paper mouse to the cheese in the fewest steps?

tool.name: SCAMPER
tool.intro: SCAMPER is 7 magic question words for changing an idea. Today you'll use all 7 on your maze, and predict what each change teaches the mouse.

parts.name: Substitute
parts.starter: I'll swap the cheese reward for…

parts.name: Adapt
parts.starter: Like a puppy's treat, the mouse gets…

parts.name: Modify
parts.example: 🪥 A fatter handle for small hands.
parts.starter: If the trap penalty gets bigger…

parts.name: Put to another use
parts.example: 🪥 An old one cleans bike chains.

parts.name: Eliminate
parts.starter: If I remove a wall, the mouse…

parts.name: Reverse
parts.what: Flip it or turn it around.
parts.starter: If the start and cheese swap places…

sketch_checklist: I placed the start, the cheese, a wall and a trap.
I chose my rewards, like cheese +10, wasted step -1, trap -5.
I predicted the path the mouse should learn.

test.check_question: Does the mouse learn to avoid the trap?

reflection.question: AI check: what could go wrong if you rewarded the wrong thing, like rewarding speed but not safety?
